name: Papaveretum
summary: Papaveretum (BAN) is a preparation containing a mixture of hydrochloride salts of opium alkaloids. Since 1993, papaveretum has been defined in the British Pharmacopoeia (BP) as a mixture of 253 parts morphine hydrochloride, 23 parts papaverine hydrochloride, and 20 parts codeine hydrochloride. It is commonly marketed to medical agencies under the trade name Omnopon.

uses.text: It is commonly marketed to medical agencies under the trade name Omnopon. Although the use of papaveretum is now relatively uncommon following the wide availability of single-component opiates and synthetic opioids (e.g. pethidine), it is still used to relieve moderate to severe pain and for pre-operative sedation.

pharmacology.en: Its effects come mainly from the morphine it contains, which acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor. The other alkaloids contribute little pain relief.
pharmacology.zh: 它的作用主要來自所含的嗎啡，嗎啡是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑。其他生物鹼對止痛的貢獻很小。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的作用主要来自所含的吗啡，吗啡是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂。其他生物碱对止痛的贡献很小。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: It is a measured mixture of the natural alkaloids of opium rather than a single drug, and it is still occasionally used in British surgery under the name Omnopon.
fact.zh: 它是鴉片天然生物鹼按比例調配的混合物，而非單一藥物，至今在英國手術中仍偶爾以 Omnopon 的名稱使用。
fact.zhHans: 它是鸦片天然生物碱按比例调配的混合物，而非单一药物，至今在英国手术中仍偶尔以 Omnopon 的名称使用。
